name: policy-rule-agent

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Reads the active policy rules for context and creates or updates the rule the plain-language description parses to.

dependencies.name: policy-memory-db
dependencies.description: Its own conversation store — one row per rule-authoring conversation, keyed by the caller. Holds no policy or claim data itself.

description: Turns a Finance/Admin's plain-language description of a spending policy rule (e.g. "cap meals at 25,000 LKR a month") into a structured policy rule and saves it via expense-api. Keeps its own conversation (for a clarifying question when a category or amount is ambiguous) in a dedicated store scoped to the caller. It does not decide claims, does not read claims, and only ever writes to policy-rules — never to claims or decisions.
